Method of Attack: Targets Redis servers vulnerable to CVE-2022-0543
Abuses Redis replication feature to spread, creating replicas of infected instances
Scans for SSH servers with weak credentials and uploads MIPS binary via SFTP and SCP
Attempts to run Redis server on MIPS devices through OpenWRT package 'redis-server'
Embedded 64-bit Windows DLL acts as loadable module for Redis to enable shell command execution
Evasion mechanisms including checking 'TracerPid' to detect analysis tools and terminate, disabling Linux core dumps, and evading virtual machines
Impacted Systems: Devices with 32-bit MIPS processors such as routers and IoT devices
Systems in the United States, Germany, the UK, Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, and China
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Redis server vulnerability CVE-2022-0543
